t: The Timeguard STFMMINI is a reliable flush-mounted PIR motion sensor designed for automatic indoor lighting control. Ideal for hallways, utility rooms, and commercial spaces requiring efficient energy management. Features adjustable time-on duration and lux levels for tailored operation, alongside a manual override function. An IP44 rating ensures protection against dust and splashes, providing long-lasting performance for domestic and commercial electrical installations. Supports up to 1000W resistive and 200W LED loads. 360° detection angle with a 6m diameter detection coverage at a 3m mounting height. Suitable for 1000W resistive, 200W LED/Fluorescent or Low energy loads.
